title: agent-orchestrator fleet-health signal family (issue #498)
description: The declared, closed machine shape of the fleet's OWN health signals as they leave the process for the monitoring plane. Consumes ADR-0022 (docs/decision-records/ADR-0022-telemetry-exposition-authority-split.md): OTLP/HTTP push, plane-owned endpoint, flag-gated OFF, and a closed bounded label set. The labels are counts and closed-set states ONLY — a session id is this fleet's pod_id and is refused by kushin77/monitoring-stack#178. The declared values are mirrored, and enforced at construction, by fleet/health_signals.py.

serviceName.description: The constant service label (ADR-0022 D5 bounds it to one value).

labelKey.description: The closed label set. Nothing else may be emitted; identity-shaped keys (session_id, worktree, branch, agent, commit, host, ...) are refused by name.

rung.description: The supervised rungs, derived from fleet/watchdog.py's own table.

rungState.description: fleet/watchdog.decide's own closed vocabulary, plus the honest no-data member. A stale beat may never be published as healthy; an unjudgeable drift comparison is `cannot-assess` (#739, AO-GR-25), which is likewise never healthy; a rung on the local HEAD while origin/master is ahead is `checkout-behind` (#773, AO-GR-21) — the checkout is stale, which is a different fact from the rung being stale; and a rung on the local HEAD whose venue cannot be fast-forwarded (a stranded branch) is `stranded-venue` (#1790), where no fast-forward exists and the state is never healthy.

beatAgeBucket.description: The beat-age bucket, split at channel.STALE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS. An unreadable beat is OMITTED rather than bucketed, because rung_state already publishes the watchdog's measured verdict for that rung.

reconcileOutcome.description: governance/reconcile's own vocabulary: the judge's status (Action.status) and the teardown outcome (Action.outcome), both imported, plus the honest no-data member. Disjoint sets, so one closed label carries both facets. `shelved` (unmerged work kept) may never be published as `reclaimed`.

watchdogVerdict.description: fleet/channel.capability_finding's closed capability kinds (issue #319), plus the honest no-data member. Only rungs channel.CAPABILITY_RUNGS declares are published.

name.description: fleet.<kind>, one series family per declared signal kind.

unit.description: UCUM: `1` dimensionless, `s` seconds, `{lane}` a count of lanes.
